message.content: {"reason":"Shows voting pattern and VoteCast event assertion, but uses different contract, grantVotingPower, and event argument order, so only partially useful.","rating":1}
message.reasoning: We need rating. The test is for different contract DAOGovernance with grantVotingPower etc. Our target has propose, castVote, queue, execute. The test checks voting against, expects VoteCast event with args (proposalId, voter, false, weight). Our contract's VoteCast event args are (address voter, uint256 proposalId, bool support, uint256 weight). Order differs. Also test uses grantVotingPower which target doesn't have; voting power comes from token balance, not internal. So not directly adaptable. But pattern of voting and expecting event is useful. So rating 1. Reason within 30 words.
